birth.name: Name
charts.style_note: Charts are drawn in the {style} style. Changing the style changes nothing about the calculation: the same placements are drawn in a different arrangement.
cover.disclaimer: This document reports what a deterministic rule engine calculated from a birth chart. It is not a prediction of events, not advice, and not a validated statement of any tradition.
cover.title: Jyotish Analysis
dasha.running: Running periods at the analysed moment
reliability.boundary_text: The calculation does not resolve the sign or nakshatra of: {bodies}. Their classification is uncertain within the engine's own error envelope, independently of the birth time.
reliability.changes: What changes within the birth-time uncertainty
reliability.four_claims_text: Computationally tested, externally benchmarked, textual source located and tradition-validated are four different claims. This engine asserts the fourth for nothing.
reliability.not_calculated: Birth-time sensitivity was not calculated for this chart. Nothing below has been shown to be stable against a small change in the recorded time.
reliability.stable: Nothing in this chart changes within {minutes} minutes either side of the recorded time.
reliability.treated_as: The birth time was treated as {precision}.
reliability.unstable: At least one classification in this chart changes within the smallest window tested.
sources.intro: Every rule used above, with where its statement was located. Passages are cited, never reproduced: this application stores locators and short summaries, not text.
sources.note: A located source means a passage has been found and read. It does not mean a scholar has confirmed that the passage states this rule.
sources.unresolved: References this build could not resolve
strength.approximation: The strength of {planets} includes at least one component this engine computes by an approximation the source text does not state.
strength.note: Shadbala is the ratio of computed total strength to the strength the source text requires for that graha. It is a measured quantity, not a judgement.
summary.activated: Areas the engine reports as activated in this period
summary.none_active: No life area reaches the activation threshold for this moment under the profile in use.
summary.silent: area(s) are reported as silent: the methodology profile in use does not admit enough evidence to say anything about them.
transits.note: These are positions, not interpretations. What a transit is taken to activate is decided in the synthesis layer, under the rules recorded there.
windows.none: No timing window could be derived for any area from the dasha boundaries and transit events available.
windows.note: Activation and confidence are ordinal bands, not probabilities. A window is the interval in which the engine's conditions hold, not a forecast that anything happens in it.
yogas.counted: The rule profile in use evaluated {total} rules and found {present} bearing on this chart: {names}
yogas.note: A yoga's validation status describes how far its rule has been traced to a text, not how strongly it operates.
